economic_hypothesis: A broad bull market is strong when the cross-sectional median has gained at least 5% over twenty sessions and at least 60% of stocks are positive. An industry that remains in the top 30% for five sessions is a persistent leadership state rather than a one-day rotation. The first twenty-session stock breakout on expanded turnover expresses continued capital concentration in that main line.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: positive-ret20 share>50%; ret20 percentile>=70% now and five sessions ago

base_state.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
base_state.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
base_state.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
base_state.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R2_TOP20_PERSISTENT: R1 and industry percentile>=80% now and t-5

stock.first_breakout: close>=prior20 high; previous close<its then-prior20 high
